goals: Verify that the GET /posts endpoint returns a 200 status code and an empty array when no posts exist in the database.
activities: Mock the prisma.post.findMany function to resolve with an empty array.
Initialize and configure an Express application with JSON parsing and the main router.
Send a GET request to the /posts endpoint using the Express application.
Assert that the response status code is 200.
Assert that the response body is an empty array.
